 pull request adds a package or command without a page.
+
+## The site (phase 3)
+
+`px1 docs site --out DIR` renders the pages as a static website:
+
+- a sidebar of every page by section, with a dot for its status;
+- search over titles, headings and text, in the browser, with no service;
+- on each page: its status, whether it was verified or generated, an outline,
+  and the code it covers, linked to the source when `--source-url` is given;
+- `md/NAME.md`, the page's Markdown exactly as it is in the repository, linked
+  from the page, and `manifest.json`.
+
+Links between pages become links within the site. Raw HTML inside a page is
+dropped, so a page cannot inject script. The site has no build step and no
+network dependency: fonts and scripts are files in the output, and every page
+works with JavaScript off (only search and the theme switch need it).
+
+Not built yet: publishing the site on Pages with a preview per pull request,
+and the "changed in this pull request" view, which needs phase 4.

explanations.title: Add the documentation site command
explanations.summary: `px1 docs site` is now available with a required output directory, optional source and commit details, and the repository’s bundled fonts. It reports how many files it wrote.

explanations.title: Build a validated static site
explanations.summary: The site build checks the documentation pages first and stops with a pointer to `docs check` if they have problems. A successful build produces standalone HTML pages alongside the original Markdown and manifest.

explanations.title: Adapt links for the site
explanations.summary: Links between documentation pages are redirected to their site pages. Links to other repository files point to the supplied source URL when available; without one, they remain as written.

explanations.title: Add page context and exclude raw HTML
explanations.summary: Each page gets an outline from its headings, a verification or generation label, and links for covered code files when a source URL is supplied. The page content is rendered without passing through raw HTML from the Markdown.

explanations.title: Generate a local search index
explanations.summary: The generated search index contains each page’s title, section, headings, and text. The site’s browser-side search uses it to find pages without a separate search service.

explanations.title: Prevent stale files in site output
explanations.summary: Writing the site refuses to use a non-empty directory, preventing files left from an earlier build from being mixed into the new site.
